name: Wracking Sobs
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a vial of tears)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to be wracked with debilitating sobs and torrents of tears. For the duration of the spell, the target is sickened and blinded. A successful Will save negates the effect entirely.
